French

[edit]
French Wikipedia has an article on:
écuyer
Wikipedia fr

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Late Latin scūtārius
Old French escuier
Middle French escuyer
French écuyer

    Inherited from Middle French escuyer, from Old French escuier, inherited from Late Latin scūtārius. Doublet of scutaire.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /e.kɥi.je/, (obsolete) /e.ky.je/
    • Audio (France (Toulouse)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)

    Noun

    [edit]

    écuyer m (plural écuyers, feminine écuyère)

    1. (historical) squire, equerry
    2. rider, horseman

    Related terms

    [edit]
    • écu
    • écurie
